headline: Nyfjäll wins Finnish Open by two after second-round 62
blurb: David Nyfjäll fired a second-round 62 at Hill Side Golf Club and held on to win the Finnish Open by FootJoy at 17 under par, two shots ahead of four players tied for second.
body:
[David Nyfjäll](/david-nyfjall) won the Finnish Open by FootJoy at Hill Side Golf Club, finishing at 17 under par — two shots clear of four players who shared second place at 15 under. The Swedish player from Upsala Golfklubb built his winning total around a brilliant second-round 62, the lowest round of the tournament.

[Albin Tidén](/albin-tiden), [Jesper Hagborg Asp](/jesper-hagborg-asp), [Morten Ørum Madsen](/morten-orum-madsen) and [Sebastian Petersen](/sebastian-petersen) all finished tied at 15 under. Tidén made a strong push in the final round with a 63, while [Kasper Nyland](/kasper-nyland) also shot 63 in round three. Amateur [Saku Ellilä](/saku-ellila) was another to go very low, shooting 63 in the second round.

Nyfjäll has been a steady performer all season on the Cutter & Buck tour, with a second place at the NeH Hammarö Open and several top-five finishes. This was his first win of the season.

The field started with 104 players and 48 made the cut, which fell at two under par.
